title: Acetaminophen dosage threshold exceeded
why: The entered acetaminophen dose exceeds the configured 3000 mg threshold in this demonstration rule. This threshold is illustrative only and is not a clinically validated dosing recommendation. Actual safe dosing depends on patient-specific factors and total exposure from all medicines containing acetaminophen.
review: A qualified clinician or pharmacist should verify the dose, frequency, total daily acetaminophen exposure, other medicines and patient-specific risk factors. Do not use this prototype threshold to make prescribing decisions.
source: MediGuard AI demonstration rule DOD-001. The 3000 mg threshold is illustrative and requires clinical validation against current authoritative prescribing references before any clinical use.
